subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: "Why didn't you go to school yesterday?" said the mother to the girl. "I was ill." the girl replied. "How are you today?" the mother asked again. "Well," said the girl. "Don't worry for me."
guide_solution: Change the narrative style (Direct to Indirect Speech): The mother asked the girl why she had not gone to school the previous day. The girl replied that she had been ill. The mother asked her again how she was that day. The girl replied that she was well and told her mother not to worry for her.
